title: Stained Glass Dragon
description: A large dark red and black dragon with glowing green eyes lies coiled on broken stone in the foreground, breathing orange fire. Behind it is a massive circular stained glass window depicting two additional dragons, a castle, and flames against a dramatic twilight sky.
prompt: A massive dark red and black dragon with glowing green eyes and detailed scales lies curled on broken stone rubble in the foreground, breathing fire from its open maw. Behind the dragon is an enormous circular broken stained glass window set in a stone frame, showing multiple dragons, a castle, and flames in vibrant colored glass pieces, dramatic twilight sky with purple and blue clouds, epic fantasy style
